how_lead: The planet is split into 10 km × 10 km tiles. Claim the ones that mean something to you, from anywhere, and leave your mark on them.
steps: Sign in with Apple, Google or email and your first credit is on us. Tap any 10 km square on the planet — your street, your holiday spot, Everest — and it's yours.
Choose a colour, leave a message, add a photo or a web link. Everyone who finds the tile sees what you put there.
Claim more with credit packs, watch your name climb the top-50 leaderboard, and renew tiles before they expire a year on.

why_head_pre: Most games invent a fake map.
why_head_accent: We use the one you already know.
why_lead: Risk has six continents. Civilization has tile-based fantasy. Tileverse has Earth — every street, every coastline, every landmark you care about. Familiar enough to be personal. Big enough to never run out.
why_body: Tiles aren't ownership of real property — they're digital claims on a digital map. But seeing your home town in your colour, with your message on it, for anyone in the world to find? That's real.
stats: 10 km × 10 km tiles cover the planet. Claim any of them from anywhere — no travel required.
The global leaderboard ranks players by tiles claimed. Everyone plays on the same shared map.
Tiles only. They are not real property and confer no real-world rights. The fun is in the game.
faq: No. Tileverse tiles are digital game assets. They do not represent ownership of real property and confer no real-world rights of any kind. It's a game.
Do I need to be in a place to claim it?
No — claim anywhere on the planet from the comfort of your sofa. You don't need to physically visit Mount Everest to put your colour on it.

Everyone plays on the same shared map. A tile another player holds can't be claimed until it expires, and you see every player's colours, messages and photos as you explore. The leaderboard ranks the top 50 by tiles claimed.
Can my friends and I play together?
Yes — there's one world for everyone. Claim tiles next to each other, leave messages and photos for each other to find, and race up the leaderboard. There's no team system; it's one map, shared.

Tileverse is free to download and your first credit is free. After that you buy credit packs of 1, 5, 20 or 50 as one-off in-app purchases. Claiming a tile costs 1 credit, adding a photo to a tile costs 5 and adding a web link costs 10. There is no subscription.
Can I lose tiles I've claimed?

Only by letting them expire. A tile is yours for a year from claiming; renew it before then and it stays yours. No other player can take a tile you hold. Tiles that break the rules can be removed by moderation.
What if someone posts something nasty?
Report the tile from its details sheet and we review it. You can also block a player so you never see their tiles or messages again. Uploaded photos are screened automatically before they appear.
Will the map ever fill up?
5.1 million tiles, and any that aren't renewed open up again after a year. No.
final_body: Free to download. Pick a square. Make it yours.
